qualification: workload/oracle/budget definition only; performance NOT qualified

acceptance.criterion: Create reproducible quick and stress corpus specifications with exact expected scientific/disclosure results, labs/projects, dataset/file/history counts, realistic metadata sizes and concurrent reader/writer/intake/export scenarios.

Record machine/container/JDK/DB resources and numeric p95 latency, memory, connection, queue, stream, storage-reserve and cancellation budgets before qualification; separate cold/warm runs and state a minimum sampling procedure.

Include the 10000-entry boundary and refusal above supported limits, long-lived downloads, skewed/hidden data and cursor misuse. Scope is synthetic engineering; any budget/corpus reduction requires a recorded reason and requalification, not silent benchmark tuning.

limits: No service workload/latency or budget pass; Q01.2 implements the runner, H04.2 measures and fixes.
Quick source/slow stream materialized and independently parsed/hashed; stress recipes generated twice but 3.2 GB source not materialized.
Proposed container/queue/storage limits are acceptance configuration, not observed current enforcement.
Process-cold is distinct from filesystem-cold; actual filesystem cache isolation remains separately measured.
Q01.1/Q01.3 retain institutional corpus and target acceptance.
